title: Monohybrid cross
back: TT × tt → F1 all Tt (tall). Tt × Tt → F2 3 tall : 1 dwarf; genotypes 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt.

title: Test cross
back: Cross the unknown with the homozygous recessive parent. Dihybrid test cross gives 1 : 1 : 1 : 1.

title: Incomplete vs co-dominance
back: Incomplete: a new blended phenotype. Co-dominance: both alleles fully expressed. Both give 1 : 2 : 1 in F2.

title: ABO blood groups
back: AB = I^A I^B; O = ii. Multiple alleles (three) at one gene.

title: Morgan's linkage numbers
back: Linked genes stay together; recombination gives new types. Sturtevant mapped genes by it.

title: Sex determination
back: Grasshopper male XO; human male XY; bird female ZW (female heterogamety); honey bee drone haploid, from an unfertilised egg.

title: Pedigree symbols
back: Square male, circle female, shaded = affected, double line = consanguineous mating, diagonal = dead.

title: Sickle-cell anaemia
back: Autosomal recessive point mutation; Hb polymerises at low O₂ and RBCs sickle. Only HbˢHbˢ is ill.

title: Down vs Klinefelter vs Turner
back: Aneuploidy from failed chromatid separation. Klinefelter: sterile male with gynaecomastia. Turner: sterile female, rudimentary ovaries.

title: X-linked recessive
back: Commoner in males (8% of males colour blind, 0.4% of females). An affected daughter needs an affected father and a carrier mother.
